refinedInterpretation: The state snapshot itself is exact and metadata-identical. Only the first continuation invocation differs. The second original continuation is bitwise equal to the second restored continuation, while restored repeat 1 and 2 are also bitwise equal. This isolates the observed preflight failure away from serialization/restore corruption and toward a first-continuation runtime warm-up/order effect (for example lazy kernel/algorithm selection or other runtime/model mutation). The prior original-then-restored exactness test was order-confounded.

transportDefect.cause: RunPod log transport injected timestamps into the oversized single-line JSON marker around 16KB boundaries, making the marker invalid JSON for the polling parser.
transportDefect.restartCause: The container exited after the diagnostic while the RunPod pod desiredStatus remained RUNNING, causing the workload to restart repeatedly until the outer 1200-second orchestration timeout deleted the pod.
